quotes.author: Chris G
quotes.text: Outstanding experience! My buddy and I did the 4 hour morning bottom fishing trip. Trolled for an hour on the way to the first bottom spot with no hits, and we had only one or two fish landed at the first two spots. Then at the third and fourth spots we hit the honey holes. For the 14 people fishing we pulled up about 50-60 fish, and 35 to 40 were edible keepers. Then trolled back to the marina. Ten minutes out from the marina we had a huge hit on the down rigger. The hit turned out to be a 24 lb Ono! Wow, what a trip! The captain and two crew were awesome (Mark, Brian, and Sienna).

quotes.author: shawn zahraie
quotes.text: We first spoke with Tara and she was very professional and accommodating! We met Captain Bryan and Sienna at the slip, they too were very nice and professional! We had an amazing time fishing catching several small fish and then the magic happened while trolling back we caught 2 large Ono and most importantly my 11 year old had the time of his life! We just finished cooking our fillets Captain Bryan gave us! Soo delicious! Thanks again! We will definitely use them again!

quotes.author: Stephen Serfass
quotes.text: Captain Matt, Jaron, and Siena were great - they know what they are doing and did an excellent job of making everyone on the boat feel comfortable and secure in what we were doing. Captain Matt found the fish - we caught Goat fish, Trigger fish, and other really interesting varieties. Beautiful day, excellent experience. And Tara, who handles the administrative stuff, was also very friendly and helpful.

quotes.author: Amy Simkins
quotes.text: We had the most incredible time on our snorkel trip to Molokini and Coral Garden. The crew took great care of us… they were helpful and informative and a lot of fun. Definitely recommending this to everyone! Thank you Aloha Blue for some great family memories!

quotes.author: Hayden Desserich
quotes.text: Excellent company, didn’t catch anything the day I went out but certainly can’t blame the captain and crew. Very clean and well kept boat, and the crew was amazing. Still managed to have a great time even without catching anything.

quotes.author: Karen Garcia
quotes.text: Absolutely amazing experience on a fishing charter. Nonstop whale sightings! The captain (Bryan) and mate (Jaren) were fantastic, knowledgeable and made the experience incredibly fun. Definitely an experience of a lifetime.
